sources.evidence: Forward roles and QK/PV overlap were inspected in flash_fwd_sm100.py. Backward load, MMA, compute, dQ reduction, dKV epilogue roles, pipeline handoffs, and SMEM/TMEM aliases were inspected in FlashAttentionBackwardSm100.

authoring.goal: Explain code-derived SM100 forward and backward schedules with enough role, synchronization, and on-chip lifetime detail to reconstruct each selected path.
authoring.audience: GPU kernel engineers familiar with Blackwell TMA, tcgen05, SMEM, and TMEM.
reading_order: source-specific forward or backward operation chain
ready and release handoffs with their mechanisms
SMEM/TMEM lifetimes, sequential aliases, and epilogue reuse
required_content: exactly three top-level phases: prologue, mainloop, and epilogue
stage-indexed major matrix operations and pointwise work
SMEM/TMEM lifetimes and reuse on the same event axis
